about.title: About us
about.p1: WSA Enterprise is an integrated agricultural platform designed for modern farms, cooperatives, trainers, and agribusiness operators.
about.p2: Our mission is to connect field operations, knowledge, commerce, and talent in one secure, professional ecosystem.
about.p3: Browse public services without an account, then register to create and manage your own agricultural workspace.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: We respect your privacy and protect personal data according to applicable regulations and platform security standards.
privacy.p2: Account information, farm records, and service data are accessible only to authorized users within your organization scope.
privacy.p3: Contact your platform administrator for detailed privacy documentation specific to your deployment.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.p1: Use of WSA Enterprise is subject to your organization's service agreement and applicable local laws.
terms.p2: Paid features require an active subscription. Public browsing does not grant access to protected or paid functionality.
terms.p3: By registering, you agree to use the platform responsibly and in accordance with agricultural and business regulations.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.p1: For platform support, partnership inquiries, or deployment questions, please reach out through your organization's designated contact channel.
contact.p2: If you already have an account, sign in to access in-app notifications and organization settings.
contact.p3: New visitors can register to create a personal agricultural workspace and explore available modules.
